classification.difficultyReason: Multiply the square vertices' displacements from the given centre by three and connect the resulting points; no method selection is required.

content.prompt: Scale the square below by a factor of 3 using $O$ as the centre of enlargement.

spec.description: Seven-column, five-row writable grid with a marked centre and a unit square. A blank-grid template cannot express the supplied square and centre.
spec.mathematics: O=(1,1); original square [2,3] by [1,2] in lower-left grid coordinates.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original square and centre are visible.

answer.worked: Multiply each vertex’s displacement from $O$ by 3. The image vertices are 3 right, 6 right, 6 right and 3 up, and 3 right and 3 up from $O$. Join them to form a square of side 3 grid units.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3; matched teacher PDF page 74, Section C question 3
spec.description: Complete original grid with the factor-3 image distinguished by a blue outline.
spec.mathematics: Image square [4,7] by [1,4]; all image displacements from O=(1,1) are three times the original displacements.
spec.answerVisibility: The enlarged square is visible only in answer editions.
